evidence_status: retrospective nested rolling-origin analysis; all historical dates have been accessible to prior exploration
financial_interpretation: at least three elevated implied-volatility closes over six trading observations; analyst-defined stress persistence, not losses/defaults
inner_validation: three preceding calendar years, each predicted by an expanding fit ending before its January 1
annual_refitting: fit before January 1; frozen within each outer year; observed contexts update, parameters do not
split_boundary: six-step outcomes must end within the scored year; no cross-boundary forward labels
selection_objective: pooled inner-validation Brier for the SAME primary count event
selection_tiebreak: among candidates within 0.001 of minimum, smallest state count, then binary30
support_rule: eligible when every history has at least 25 training continuations in all three inner folds; IID and order1 retained as explicit controls even if rule fails
quantile_rule: numpy linear empirical quantiles from each fold training sample only; q80 binary, 1/3 and 2/3 ternary
cross_discretization_comparison: only binary30 and ternary20_30 share primary target; other thresholds use own targets, never compare raw losses to choose threshold

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks within each outer year; fixed fitted forecasts; no block crosses annual model boundaries

interval_scope: conditional retrospective scoring uncertainty, not a refit bootstrap or global stationarity guarantee
structural_analysis: exact rational emission signatures and partition refinement; modular probability-rank certificates; zero-phase Gram and exploratory instrument only
future_confirmatory_start: 2026-10-26; no observations currently available; do not report confirmatory results
order4_variable_length_gate: defer unless order3 has well-supported predictive improvement over simpler models; no expansion solely for quantum state count
